b: Vietnam is a communist country… The army, present everywhere, showed that clearly… But you could see both the local people and travellers moving about freely… The economy seemed to be doing reasonably well .
In Vietnam they don't fold money.. When, out of our habit, I rolled up a note, Dhanush stopped me and showed me that here not a single note is folded.. It would be good if we changed like that too

Women go out to work a lot… In the market, it's mostly women who carry the sacks too..In the shops, in the banks, it's Alli's kingdom.. It made me proud… The reason is the Vietnam War…Because so many men were lost, women got used to doing every job themselves.. Apparently only in politics and the army do women not dominate
A lot of natural resources have been destroyed in the name of tourism … and are being destroyed… Forests have been converted a lot to build theme parks
We all felt there was a bit more women's freedom .. a bit more equality between men and women… But you'd only know the truth by talking and mixing within that society
These are the things I forgot to tell you
note: Alli was a legendary Tamil queen whose kingdom was run by women.
